brief:
Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned ongoing Israeli attacks on Lebanon on Wednesday, according to Shehab Wire. The ministry praised what it called the resilience of the Lebanese people in confronting occupation forces, while reiterating Tehran's commitment to stand alongside Lebanon in defense of its sovereignty and territorial integrity.

The Iranian statement underscores deepening regional tensions as cross-border military operations have intensified in recent weeks. Tehran has positioned itself as a key backer of Lebanese armed groups and has repeatedly voiced opposition to Israeli military action in the country. The condemnation reflects Iran's broader regional posture amid escalating security concerns along the Israeli-Lebanese border.
